hazards.description: Visible cracking and minor displacement in the concrete sidewalk and steps create potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom foreground and steps leading to the house

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the curb with no physical buffer (like trees or a planting strip) to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left edge of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily patched and worn, which can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians or cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and edges of the asphalt roadway

hazards.name: Uneven and cracked sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The concrete walkway is severely degraded with large cracks and uneven slabs, creating significant tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground along the pedestrian walkway.

hazards.name: Overgrown vegetation
hazards.description: Large bushes and weeds are encroaching onto the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width and potentially blocking sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, extending from the front yard onto the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Narrow Pedestrian Clear Zone
hazards.description: The sidewalk is relatively narrow and directly abuts parked cars, offering limited space for pedestrians to pass each other comfortably.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in front of the row houses
